subject: PlaneGeometry
question:
Two machines $R$ and $S$ act on a square sheet of paper. Machine $R$ rotates the sheet $90^{\circ}$ clockwise. <image1> (Note the marking in the corner.) Machine $S$ prints on the sheet as shown. <image2> In which order must the two machines be used to produce this picture? <image3>
Choices:
A:SRRR
B:RSRR
C:SRSR
D:RRRS
E:SRRS
original_question: Anna has two machines $R$ and $S$. If she places a square piece of paper in machine $R$ it is rotated $90^{\circ}$ in a clockwise direction. <image1> (Hint: Note the marking in the corner!) If she places the piece of paper in machine $S$, it gets printed on. <image2> In which order does Anna use the two machines so that this picture is made? <image3>
